name: QE SDK 0.24 Editor QA Scaffold
author: HackHub Quest Editor
description: Evidence-only project for SDK 0.24 in-game verification: native Wi-Fi, HTTP/curl events, the Timer node delay and calendar modes, the Twotter node (accounts, backdated series, cleanup), and the pack extras (start-menu entry, desktop widget, right-click entries, translated words). Nothing auto-starts - claim one quest at a time with the harness command qe24 run - so a tester sees one row's noise, not five.
